newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - November 29.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - November 29.

text.p: The Federal Reserve had no large one-day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokesman said.
The high in natural float was about $1.45 billion on Tuesday, while the low was about negative $50 million on Friday.
Several districts reported small negative float figures and the others had relatively small positive float numbers that day, which resulted in a net negative $50 million.

Transportation float averaged a bit over $50 million per day, with the high on Tuesday at a bit under $200 million primarily due to ground transportation problems in Boston, Massachusetts and Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
